name: side lunge stretch v. 2
description: Sinking into a wide side lunge stretches the inner thigh and groin. A good opener before lower body work.
instructions: Stand with your feet wide apart and toes pointing forward.
Shift your weight to one side and bend that knee.
Keep the other leg straight with the foot flat or toes up.
Sit your hips back and feel the stretch on the inner thigh.
